//: claude-agenda settings. Every option below is at its default; null means the built-in default. An environment variable wins over the same option here. Details: README, 'Settings'.
//label_prefix: launchd label prefix for add/list/remove; always ends with '.'
//claude: Claude Code binary. null: ~/.local/libexec/claude-stable/claude if present, else claude on PATH
//tmux: tmux binary. null: tmux on PATH, else /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux or /usr/local/bin/tmux
//stale_hours: close a previous session whose status is unknown after this many hours
//default_dir: folder for run when the job gives no --dir. null: the current folder (launchd starts jobs in /)
//dir_aliases: other flag names run accepts for --dir, such as ["--folder"]; each starts with '-'
//launch_command: your own launcher, as a list with {prefix} {name} {prompt} {dir} {dir_abs} {remote_control}. null: built-in tmux launch
//idle_outside_tmux: previous session idle but not in tmux: skip, open or close
//close_command: with idle_outside_tmux close: a list with {pid} {name} {prefix} that closes it. null: SIGTERM to its process
//overdue_prefixes: label prefixes launchd-overdue checks, a list; each ends with '.'. null: [label_prefix]
//yearly_file: labels of dated jobs that repeat every year, one per line. null: ~/.config/launchd-overdue/yearly.txt
//overdue_dir: where launchd-overdue moves the plists it turns off. null: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/overdue
